title: Indic LM From Scratch — Decoder-only Transformer with RoPE + SwiGLU + KV-Cache

modules.dataset: Hindi/Hinglish text builder with synthetic generator (Devanagari + Roman mixing). SentencePiece BPE tokenizer trained on Indic text (character_coverage=0.98). PyTorch TextDataset with sequence chunking + DataLoader.
modules.model: Decoder-only Transformer (LLaMA-style): RoPE rotary position embeddings (precomputed cos/sin tables), RMSNorm (faster than LayerNorm), SwiGLU gated MLP (SiLU gate), Multi-Head causal self-attention with KV-cache, weight tying. Temperature/Top-k/Top-p sampling for generation.
modules.train: argparse CLI: AdamW + cosine LR schedule with warmup, cross-entropy loss, validation perplexity, KV-cached autoregressive generation demo, checkpoint export.
modules.tests: 10 tests: RoPE shapes (cos/sin), KV-cache output parity (identical tokens), loss reduction (training decreases loss), perplexity = exp(loss), perplexity cap, tokenizer encode/decode roundtrip, model output shape, CLI smoke.
